title: University of Eastern Finland Early Bird Discount (30%) and Tuition Waivers
program_type: Early Bird tuition discount and academic-progress tuition waiver
duration: Early Bird discount covers the first academic year; tuition waivers apply to the second and subsequent study years
description: The University of Eastern Finland offers tuition-fee-paying students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland an Early Bird discount of 30% on the first academic year's tuition, together with tuition waivers of 30% in the second and subsequent study years based on academic progress, plus Finnish Proficiency Tuition Waivers. UEF states its discounts and waivers generally cover up to 30% of tuition, that applicants cannot apply for full (100%) waivers, and that no humanitarian scholarships are offered. Tuition fees range from EUR 10,000 to EUR 12,000 per academic year.

title: University of Turku Merit Scholarship (50% of tuition) and Early Bird Discount
program_type: Academic-merit tuition fee scholarship plus first-year tuition discount
duration: The Merit Scholarship covers the following academic year: master's year two, or bachelor's years two and three
description: The University of Turku does not offer any scholarship covering tuition for the first study year. Newly admitted master's students can receive a EUR 2,000 Early Bird discount by accepting the study offer and paying tuition within 28 days of the admission decisions being published. The University of Turku Merit Scholarship, awarded on academic merit, then covers 50% of tuition for the following academic year - the second year for master's students and the second and third years for bachelor's students - provided the student has met the credit, grade and Finnish-language requirements. title: Åbo Akademi University tuition fee scholarship - early commitment offer and second-year reduction
program_type: Tuition fee discount awarded on admission and continued automatically in year two
duration: Waivers are granted only for the first two years of study at Åbo Akademi University
description: For students admitted to Åbo Akademi University international master's programmes from the autumn of 2026 onwards, the university replaced its 100% and 80% tuition fee waiver scheme with a EUR 4,000 early commitment discount in the first academic year, reducing the first-year fee to EUR 8,000, and an automatic EUR 4,000 tuition reduction in the second year. The first-year offer must be claimed by accepting the study place and paying tuition within the deadline specified in the admissions letter; failing that, the full EUR 12,000 is due.
